description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to oversee all aspects of patient care, ensure regulatory compliance, and foster a culture of excellence and compassion. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the quality of life for our residents and the professional growth of our nursing staff.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of nursing services. This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Join a team committed to providing outstanding care and making a meaningful difference in the community.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Comprehensive understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a nursing team effectively
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
